name: Project Nightfall

features.text: UV-sensitive infected types, sun damage, hibernation, shelter/evasion and Feral reserve/sprinting.
Smart stalking/ambush, screech response, personal hordes and persistent Alpha leadership/territory.
Seasonal movement, shelters/dens, lighting defense and bounded crowd behavior.
Provenance-checked body-part effigies and feeding; research files and configurable presets.
Reusable restricted effigy container; separate ordinary meat and human/regular/Feral/Smart-Feral part categories; EMPTY, MEAT_LOADED and BODY_PART_LOADED visual states. No mixed contents.
Restricted world-container server admission, transfer/feed/destruction concurrency, save migration and native visual-state transport require verified Lua-only integration and runtime evidence.

limits: Source/design review only, baseline 0.30.0. Existing combined-item effigies remain implemented; reusable container and three effigy assets are planned, not shipped. Native SP/dedicated NOT TESTED; G7 and stable G8 BLOCKED.
